issue_candidates.title: diff snapshot without baseline does not use the last session snapshot
issue_candidates.evidence: CLI, MCP, README, and docs promise latest-session comparison; handle_diff_snapshot uses String::new() when baseline is absent and no session snapshot cache exists.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Pre-existing behavior untouched by the reset diff.

issue_candidates.title: documented snapshot baseline file workflow produces a newline-only false diff
issue_candidates.evidence: Built CLI `snapshot > baseline.txt` followed by unchanged `diff snapshot --baseline baseline.txt` reports one addition and removal because the baseline has a final newline and the current snapshot does not.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Pre-existing text-normalization behavior, independent of ref numbering.

issue_candidates.evidence: parse_diff and MCP accept selector, compact, depth, screenshot, and fullPage; handle_diff_url constructs SnapshotOptions::default and never reads those fields.
